Hi Priyom,

Thanks for taking this on. AltaHealth is running a short CSA/CAIQ intake for third-party cloud vendors in our supply chain. Attached is our questionnaire (AltaHealth_CSA_Questionnaire.xlsx). We need: 
- Completed CAIQ responses (questions mapped to Redwood controls)
- A simple evidence index that maps each control to a document or artifact and an owner
- Confirmation on how evidence will be transferred (SFTP, Box, or presigned links)

Deadline: we need the returned package by EOD 2027-04-07 so our audit team can begin review the following week.

1) Provide the CAIQ answers in spreadsheet form (we prefer to see Accepted/Partial/Not-Applicable + short rationale).
2) For evidentiary items (policies, diagrams, configuration screenshots, SOC 2 bridge docs) include a clear owner and an expected delivery date if you can't attach immediately.
3) If any items require redaction or a tighter access control, flag them — we can provide a restricted Box folder with viewer-only access.

Thanks — can we schedule a 30m kickoff Wed 3/31 or Thu 4/1 to go over scope and owners?

Best,

4) Finalize (by 2027-04-07): address any clarifying questions from AltaHealth and update package.
